reason_text.dmarc_fail: The sender's domain ({domain}) says it did not send this (DMARC failed).
reason_text.spf_fail: It came from a server {domain} does not send from (SPF failed).
reason_text.dkim_fail: Its signature does not check out (DKIM failed).
reason_text.own_domain_unverified: It says it is from your own domain ({domain}), but nothing proves it.
reason_text.name_has_other_address: The sender's name shows {shown}, but it came from {actual}.
reason_text.brand_mismatch: The sender's name says {brand}, but it came from {domain}.
reason_text.brand_in_subject: It says it is from {brand} and asks you to act, but it came from {domain}.
reason_text.lookalike_domain: {domain} looks like {like}, but is not it.
reason_text.punycode_sender: The sender's domain ({domain}) is written in look-alike characters.
reason_text.link_text_mismatch: A link shows {shown} but goes to {actual}.
reason_text.link_userinfo: A link hides where it goes behind {shown} (it goes to {actual}).
reason_text.link_to_ip: A link goes to a bare address ({actual}), not a named site.
reason_text.link_punycode: A link goes to {actual}, written in look-alike characters.
reason_text.page_attachment: {name} opens a web page, which is how fake sign-in pages travel.
reason_text.credential_lure: It asks you to act on your account ("{phrase}") and has a link.
reason_text.upstream_spam: A mail server on the way marked it as spam.
reason_text.bulk_no_unsubscribe: It is bulk mail with no way to unsubscribe.
